structuralContract.faceSegmentsMeaning: Discrete structural-tier delta already resolved by haven_world; it is not a pixel-height multiplier.

featureHeightPolicy.ramp: One structural tier only; use the authored ramp/diagonal connector family without vertical stretching.
featureHeightPolicy.cave: Cave mouth is a fixed authored terminal feature. Taller host cliffs add certified rock continuation above the mouth; the opening itself must not be stretched or repeated.
featureHeightPolicy.waterfall: Waterfall is a fixed animated connector family. Taller drops repeat/extend only its certified flow-middle modules once waterfall-specific certification is completed.
featureHeightPolicy.vines: Decorative/climbable vine coverage must use authored vine continuation cells/windows and may not substitute generic rock by visual guess.

rules: Never stretch a cliff source cell to create height.
Never multiply structural elevation units into arbitrary pixel rows after face_segments has been resolved.
Insert complete 32x32 authored repeat-body modules between fixed authored top/rim and foot/base modules.
Repeat multi-column terminal body rows as complete natural-scale rows.
Collision projection depth grows by the same one world row per additional authored middle module.
Special features remain anchored and use their own certified continuation family rather than stretching the feature.

supersedes.runtimeAssumption: additional structural levels repeat two rock-body rows
supersedes.replacement: one complete authored middle module per additional structural tier

next: finish exact concave/terminal/ramp placement certification, then freeze cliffs and move to authored shoreline/water
